name: Web-based racing mapping and navigation app

mentions.name: Web-based racing mapping and navigation app
mentions.description: A web-based mapping and navigation application designed to cover what existing mapping products don't, with racing-oriented features such as raceline analysis, driving aids, Dakar rally support, and CANBUS/OBD vehicle data integration for race cars. A passion project.
mentions.problem: Existing mapping and navigation products don't do what the author needs, particularly racing-related features.
mentions.source_excerpt: Web based mapping and navigation application that basically does everything all the other products don't do. Raceline analysis, driving aids, Dakar rally, CANBUS, OBD, Nightrider for race cars? or something. Passion project whatever. Investors get lost.

evidence.value: Web based mapping and navigation application that basically does everything all the other products don't do. Raceline analysis, driving aids, Dakar rally, CANBUS, OBD, Nightrider for race cars? or something. Passion project whatever. Investors get lost.
